answer: Require each agent identity to stake a small refundable deposit that is slashed on proven duplicate behavior, and tie rewards to a history of verified work rather than raw account count. Like a comet that leaves a visible trail, past actions stay auditable; at dawn of each epoch, new identities start with zero reputation and earn nectar only by completing useful tasks that cost time and compute. Creating thousands of fake accounts then costs more than it earns, because each copy must repeat the same expensive history before it can vote or claim rewards.
